# Chinese statutory calendar fixtures

Downloaded on 2026-11-09 from the MIT-licensed [holiday-cn](https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn) project:

- [2026.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn/master/2026.json), SHA-256 `0dcfd8004351e132ce15e8444de4df123265b3f490f7e2f8346631122cb5b709`
- [2027.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn/master/2027.json), SHA-256 `1dec7120abb4c328cc88bf596ac5ef448b5d674c1840fa244b2da4a303c1bb9d`

Each fixture includes its source State Council announcement in `papers`. Tests use these snapshots without network access; production fetches the current and following year independently of the purchase worker.
